title: Glyco Combined Digital Catalogue CATGY2201: Porsche M64.60 bearing dimensions
notes: Porsche engine entry 26, PDF p.832 / printed p.802 explicitly lists M64.60, M64.60R and M64.60RS. English legend PDF p.9 / printed VII and German legend PDF p.11 / printed IX define journal/housing limits, maximum bearing width, maximum wall thickness, oil clearance and crank-web distance. Data are supplier specifications, not measurements on a user engine or factory wear limits. PDF p.832, p.9 and related 2015 table were visually inspected. Same manufacturer family as the older Federal-Mogul catalogue; these editions are not independent physical attestations. Reviewed on 2026-10-24.
